project.title: Strong Green forms and arithmetic heights
project.subtitle: Actual forms · Exact support · Arithmetic intersections
project.summary: A programme on non-Archimedean Green forms and the construction of Beilinson–Bloch height pairings.
project.motivation: A local theory of Green forms should connect analytic constructions on Berkovich spaces with global arithmetic intersection theory. This project studies that connection through precise formulations of zero-curvature Green problems and the compatibility needed for height pairings.
project.programme:
## Local analytic constructions
Formulate Green problems with explicit test spaces, support conditions and normalization conventions.

## Compatibility and descent
Study finite traces, descent, and compatibility with intersection operations.

## Arithmetic height pairings
Organize the local constructions and their global compatibility into a long-term proof programme.

## Research records
Precise conjectures, proof texts and their source references will enter this project through versioned research releases.
